name: Protection from Evil and Good

header.Components: V, S, M (a flask of Holy Water worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

casting.material: a flask of Holy Water worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

authored_intent: Touch willing creature and consume flask of Holy Water worth 25+ GP; source-defined creature types attack at Disadvantage, cannot newly Charm/Frighten/Possess; existing such effects get new-save Advantage rather than automatic removal.

rules.text: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against creatures that are Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, or Undead.
Creatures of those types have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the target.
The target also can’t be possessed by or gain the Charmed or Frightened conditions from them.
If the target is already possessed, Charmed, or Frightened by such a creature, the target has Advantage on any new saving throw against the relevant effect.
